what: Blind figure readings (made by an AI reading agent working for MV2 of Munim, Inc., without sight of any of MV2's files or model output), 2026-11-19. Units MW m^-2 K^-1 and K.

khan2024.citation: S. Khan, X. Shi, J. Feser, R. Wilson, 'Thermal conductance of interfaces between titanium nitride and group IV semiconductors at high temperatures', Appl. Phys. Lett. 125 (2024), doi 10.1063/5.0220124; free copy OSTI 2578597
khan2024.G_at_note: best reading at each 100 K step, linear interpolation between measured points; null = not measured
khan2024.curves_note: Legend names: 'Elastic Limit', 'DMM', 'inelastic limit (= TiN Gmax)' and 'Diamond Gmax' (diamond panel); 'Elastic Limit', 'DMM', 'inelastic limit (= Si Gmax)' and 'TiN Gmax' (Si panel). R_TiN and R_other are the two sides' maximum (radiation-limit) conductances. No AGF or radiation-limit curve beyond these is shown. Values at 300 K and at 1000 K.
khan2024.high_T_wording: the interface conductance increases monotonically without stagnating at higher temperatures
khan2024.reading_uncertainty: +-5-15 on clear markers (+-1-2 %); +-20-30 on the partly hidden TiN/Si points 480-771 K; curves +-2-3 %
khan2024.not_read: TiN thickness, substrate orientations, SiC polytype and growth details are in the Supplementary Information, which was not opened

koh2020.citation: Y. R. Koh et al., 'Thermal boundary conductance across epitaxial metal/sapphire interfaces', Phys. Rev. B 102, 205304 (2020); free copy NSF PAR 10231106
koh2020.G_note: the last value is at the highest measured temperature: 498 K (Al), 497 K (Co), 498 K (Ru)
koh2020.curves_note: 'modal non-equilibrium Landauer' with DMM transmission (Shi et al.'s method); conventional DMM not shown for these interfaces
